title: Object cohomology presheaf is homology of a supplied injective resolution
statement: Let C be a category with objects in universe u and morphisms in universe v, and J a Grothendieck topology [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Assume abelian sheafification with coefficients AddCommGrpCat in universe v [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and HasExt in universe w for the abelian sheaves on J. Let F be an abelian sheaf, I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and q a natural number. Apply sheafToPresheaf to I degreewise, and let K be the resulting cochain complex of presheaves. The object cohomology presheaf H^q(-,F), lifted from universe w to max(u,v,w), is naturally isomorphic to the presheaf K.homology q, lifted from universe v to max(u,v,w). No existence of a resolution is asserted: I is supplied. Naturality is with respect to every morphism of objects of C.

source.place: Section 01FT, definition of cohomology over an object; Tag 03F3, proof. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03F3; the Ext/free-representable encoding is Mathlib SheafCohomology.Basic.

proof.text: Use InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and CohomologyClass.homAddEquiv to identify the object-cohomology groups with maps from the degree-zero free representable sheaf to the shifted integer extension of the supplied resolution in the homotopy category. These additive equivalences are defined in resolutionHomotopyEquiv.

Prove restriction compatibility in resolutionHomotopyEquiv_naturality: write each Ext element as extMk using extMk_surjective, apply mk₀_comp_extMk, and identify precomposition on cocycles and in the homotopy category using fromSingleMk_precomp and equivHomShift_symm_precomp. Specialize to the sheafified free abelian Yoneda functor. Apply the explicit additive ULift equivalences and assemble a natural isomorphism with NatIso.ofComponents.

Apply the Hom-sections homology comparison to I.cocomplex and compose the resulting natural isomorphisms. This remaining lemma concerns an arbitrary nonnegative complex, without any Ext or injective-resolution assumption.

proof_origin.place: Section 01FT and Tag 03F3; Derived Categories Tag 06XR (1).
proof_origin.note: Second reader P1 replaces an equivalent component restatement with a real reduction: Ext to homotopy classes and its naturality are proved; only the Hom-sections homology comparison remains open.

from.place: Injective-resolution computation of object cohomology used in the Tag 09AX effacement argument; presheaf naturality before taking Zariski stalks.

lean.statement:
theorem objectCohomologyPresheaf_resolution
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})]
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      (Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf F q ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{max u v, w} ≅
        (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
          I.cocomplex).homology q ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{max u w, v})
